title: Django, asynchronous views
notes: The generated Django project with async views on Uvicorn (ASGI).
details: The Django entry with two changes. The views are coroutines (`async def`, in shop/views_async.py, routed by config/settings_async.py, which only sets ROOT_URLCONF); /about is an `async def` view calling render() rather than a TemplateView, whose unrendered response Django's asynchronous handler would render on a thread. Served through the generated config/asgi.py by Uvicorn (one process, loop=asyncio, http=h11, lifespan off, access log off) on a thread inside the one measured process, in place of WSGI on Waitress. The settings are otherwise the generated ones: all default apps, middleware and context processors.
